sse2.description: main build: -O2 default x86-64 target, SSE2 16-byte vectors

novec.description: scalar build: no loop vectorisation and no omp simd directive

avx2.description: AVX2 32-byte vectors, no FMA (-mfma not given; ISO C11 mode also disables contraction)

openmp_environment.OMP_NUM_THREADS: set per configuration to the thread count p
openmp_environment.OMP_PROC_BIND / OMP_PLACES: not set: libgomp on Windows does not implement places; threads are pinned by the program (--affinity)

input.reused_from: Assignment 1 generator (scripts/generate_inputs.py, commit 441ae4d), also used in Assignment 2

scaling.description: Main study: sequential baselines and their OpenMP versions for every thread count

affinity.description: Supplementary: thread placement (no pinning, compact, spread) at a fixed size

vectorization.description: Optional extension: scalar, SSE2 and AVX2 builds of the same source, at fixed thread counts

simd_directive.description: Diagnostic: the parallel blocked kernel without the omp simd directive
